title: Smoke (Qwen3.5-122B on 2x H100): does the model split over two cards reproduce two cells of the one-H200 parts run?
command: BJ_TARGET=qwen3.5-122b-a10b BJ_DEVICE_MAP=auto BJ_BATCH=16 uv run python scripts/statement_positions.py parts --name qwen35_122b_d1_smoke_h100 --map qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_map --why "H100 smoke: the 122B split over 2x H100 at two cells of qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_parts" --lo 24 --sets bind_bridge context --force bind_bridge:30 context:30 && BJ_TARGET=qwen3.5-122b-a10b uv run python scripts/d1_verdict.py --map qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_map --parts qwen35_122b_d1_smoke_h100 --tasks-set d1_topics_v2 --cell bind_bridge:30 && BJ_TARGET=qwen3.5-122b-a10b uv run python scripts/d1_verdict.py --map qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_map --parts qwen35_122b_d1_smoke_h100 --tasks-set d1_topics_v2 --cell context:30
question: On the new 2x H100 PCIe 80 GB box, with Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (FP8) split over both cards, do the lens part's lookup switching and the cell verdict at the bridge's sentence and the context at layer 30 match the one-H200 run qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_parts?
why_it_matters: The FP8 122B does not fit one 80 GB card, so every 122B run on this box splits the model over two GPUs. Other hardware and the device split need not give byte-identical numbers; before any new 122B run here (the late cells, A1, A3) the split must reproduce an opened result.

hypotheses.H-reproduces: at both cells the lens part (jspace) switches lookups (PP) within 3 points of the original run (bind_bridge:30 15.6% [11, 22], context:30 19.4% [14, 26]; n=180 each, from results/statement_positions/qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_parts/outcomes.jsonl) and the cell verdict is the same as the original's (does not replicate at both). Prior: none set by the agent
hypotheses.H-differs: at either cell the lens part's lookup share moves more than 3 points or the verdict changes: all 122B work on this box stops and Dan is told

decision_rule: Dan's rule (23 Oct): each cell (bind_bridge:30, context:30), the lens-part lookup share within +-3 points of the original run's and the same verdict, else stop and write to Dan. Lens-part lookup share: the share of PP rows (part jspace, source cf, not null) whose top token is the other bridge's answer (role b), at the cell, pooled over topics, n=180. Verdict: scripts/d1_verdict.py's replication rule at that cell (--cell SET:LAYER: replicates iff the lens part switches <= 0.10 of lookups and the rest >= 0.50 while PM's lens part switches >= 0.30; else does not replicate, or not interpretable), computed the same way on both runs. Both numbers are read from each run's outcomes.jsonl. The same n (180 per family and cell) is required.
controls: the original run qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_parts (one H200, the same 180 scenes per family, map, lens and seeds; its cells bind_bridge and context at layers 24, 27, 30)
reported beside the lens part, from both runs: the whole copy, the rest (not_jspace), rand_omp (a 25-atom OMP over a random dictionary), and the recalls (PM) at the same cells
n: 180 scenes per family (PP lookups, PM recalls), d1_topics_v2, 2 cells
notes: Dan, 23 Oct ~14:00: smoke before everything on the rented 2x H100 PCIe 80 GB box (sesterce-h100x2). The same scenes, map (qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_map), lens (the published J++, pinned, sha256-checked) and code path as qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_parts (the _r3 command), restricted with --force to the two cells; the null seeds depend on the case index, the set's index in SETS, the layer and the part's index, all unchanged, so the same rows get the same random directions. Differences from the original: the model split over two GPUs (BJ_DEVICE_MAP=auto: accelerate's balanced split, the embedding and the lens on GPU 0), H100 instead of H200 kernels, fewer jobs per case (2 sets instead of 3 at layer 30, so other read batches) and the current code (rand_sub and any part added since, all after the original parts: their seeds unchanged). mem_gb is the total over the job's two GPUs (jobq, 23 Oct). Batch 16 as the original; if it does not fit the split (OOM), a new id with a lower batch, recorded here as a deviation. The run also computes rand_sub at these cells, which the late-cells run (qwen35_122b_d1_late_parts) pre-registers and Dan has not opened: its numbers in this run's summary are not read or reported. No figures stage: statement_positions' figures stage does not draw PP / PM parts runs (KeyError 'PP' on qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_parts, checked 23 Oct); the judgement is the two cells' numbers next to the original's.

title: Late switch (Qwen3.5-122B): does the lookup stop using the lens-readable part of a stated bridge at later layers?
command: BJ_TARGET=qwen3.5-122b-a10b uv run python scripts/d1_precheck.py --gate qwen35_122b_lens_gate_v2 --competence qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_competence --min-topics 0 && BJ_TARGET=qwen3.5-122b-a10b BJ_DEVICE_MAP=auto BJ_BATCH=16 uv run python scripts/statement_positions.py parts --name qwen35_122b_d1_late_parts --map qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_map --why "Late switch on 122B: the parts at the later cells" --lo 24 --sets bind_bridge context --force bind_bridge:30 bind_bridge:33 bind_bridge:36 context:24 context:30 context:33 context:36 && BJ_TARGET=qwen3.5-122b-a10b uv run python scripts/d1_verdict.py --rule late-switch --map qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_map --parts qwen35_122b_d1_late_parts --tasks-set d1_topics_v2 --cells bind_bridge:30 bind_bridge:33 bind_bridge:36 context:30 context:33 context:36 --reference context:24
figures_command: BJ_TARGET=qwen3.5-122b-a10b uv run python scripts/d1_verdict.py --rule late-switch --parts qwen35_122b_d1_late_parts --figures
question: At later cells (the bridge's sentence and the whole context, at layers 30, 33 and 36), does the lens-readable part of a stated bridge's change still switch the lookups on Qwen3.5-122B, and does it still switch the recalls?
why_it_matters: Finding 2 (a lookup ignores the lens-readable part of a stated bridge) failed on the 122B at the map's cell (the context at layer 24: the lens part switched 29% [23, 36] of lookups, n=180; recalls 38% [31, 45]; the rest 75% [68, 81]). The lens-free map shows the bridge still at its position at layers 33-38, so if the finding holds later on the 122B, what changes is the form the lookup reads there, not the place (a late switch); if the lens part keeps switching lookups at every later cell, finding 2 fails on the 122B.

hypotheses.H-late-switch: at some decisive later cell the lens part switches <= 5% of lookups (Wilson upper bound) while the rest switches >= 30% (point), there the lens part still switches >= 30% of recalls, above a random subspace of its size, and it stays <= 10% of lookups (upper bound) at the later decisive cells of the same position set. Prior: Dan's (predictions/), none set by the agent
hypotheses.H-fails: at every decisive later cell the lens part switches >= 20% of lookups (Wilson lower bound), above a random subspace of its size: finding 2 fails on the 122B. Prior: Dan's
hypotheses.H-inconclusive: neither (e.g. the lens part drops to 5-20%, or the split holds but a control fails). Prior: Dan's

decision_rule: Written 23 Oct ~12:00 +0200 before any run (scripts/d1_verdict.py --rule late-switch; the replication rule is untouched). The hypothesis was named "late binding" until Dan renamed it "late switch" (23 Oct afternoon, before any run; the logic is unchanged): the map shows the bridge still at its position at layers 33-38, so the form changes, not the place. Precheck as the 122B D1 specs: runs only if the lens gate passed (qwen35_122b_lens_gate_v2; else exit 3, logged). Cells: the bridge's sentence (bind_bridge) and the context at layers 30, 33, 36 (all on the 122B's coarse grid, every 3rd layer; 33 is the 122B's answer onset, so these cells are forced past the parts stage's usual window). A cell decides iff the lens-free map (qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_map, fixed) has it in transit for lookups: bind_bridge 30 and 33, context 30, 33 and 36; bind_bridge 36 is reported only (C's whole copy flips 36% of lookups there, not in transit). context:24 is re-run as the earlier reference (rand_sub there; the earlier 29% reproduced), not decisive. Rates: share of items whose top token is the other bridge's answer, Wilson 95%, pooled over topics. LATE SWITCH holds iff at some decisive cell (a) the lens part's (jspace) lookup switching has Wilson upper bound <= 0.05, (b) the rest (not_jspace) switches >= 0.30 of lookups (point estimate), (c) recall control: the lens part switches >= 0.30 of recalls at that cell (point; PP and PM get the identical patch at statement cells, so the lens part is big enough to act there), (d) random-subspace control: on recalls the lens part's Wilson lower bound is above rand_sub's upper bound (the lens part acts beyond its size), and (e) it stays quiet (amended by Dan 23 Oct 12:30, before any run): at every later decisive cell of the same position set (the bridge's sentence, or the context) the lens part's lookup switching has Wilson upper bound <= 0.10; a lens part that goes quiet and then comes back does not hold. FINDING 2 FAILS on the 122B iff at every decisive cell the lens part's lookup switching has Wilson lower bound >= 0.20 and above rand_sub's upper bound on lookups (not a size effect). Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE, the reason named. The two are exclusive (an upper bound <= 5% cannot meet a lower bound >= 20%). Confirmed by Dan 23 Oct 12:30 (proposed by the agent): the lower bound (not the point) for 'fails'; controls (c) and (d) and the rand_sub condition in 'fails'; transit as the decisive-cell filter. Reported per cell for lookups and recalls (the lookup vs recall split): whole copy, lens part, rest, the rest at the lens part's size (not_jspace_matched, added 23 Oct afternoon for A2, not decisive here), rand_sub, jspace_matched, rand_omp, the lens part's random-direction null, median shares of the change (lens part, rand_sub, rand_omp); per topic (not decisive). Only layers 33 and 36 are new evidence: bind_bridge:30, context:30 and the reference context:24 repeat cells of qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_parts on the same 180 scenes (a determinism check, not new evidence).
controls: rand_sub (new, 23 Oct): C's copy projected per row on a random subspace (the first k directions of a random orthonormal basis, seed 888 + layer), k chosen per row so it keeps the lens part's share of the row's squared norm (the same size per position, item and cell)
PM (recalls) on the same scenes as the positive control: the identical patch at statement cells

reported: not_jspace_matched (the rest, each row rescaled to the lens part's norm), jspace_matched (per row the same distribution as rand_sub, independent random directions per row), rand_omp (25-atom OMP over a random dictionary, smaller share), the lens part's random-direction null
the map's transit (C's whole copy against O's copy and a random-direction copy) picks the decisive cells; the lens gate (qwen35_122b_lens_gate_v2, via scripts/d1_precheck.py)
determinism: bind_bridge:30, context:30 and context:24 repeat qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_parts's cells on the same scenes (that run on one H200, this one split over two H100s)
n: 180 scenes per family (PP lookups and PM recalls), d1_topics_v2 (the draw-2 topics run's scenes, right on every prompt), 7 cells
notes: Dan, 23 Oct ~11:40: pre-register now and run on a rented H200 (no box up at writing; a fresh 1x or 2x H200). Amended by Dan 23 Oct 12:30, before any run: late binding also needs condition (e), the lens part staying quiet (Wilson upper bound <= 10% of lookups) at every later decisive cell of the same position set; the agent's four choices confirmed. Updated 23 Oct afternoon (A4, Dan, before any run): the hypothesis renamed 'late switch' (rule logic unchanged; d1_verdict's rule id late-switch); the part not_jspace_matched added last (after rand_sub), so every earlier part, seed and null keeps its place; the run moves to the rented 2x H100 PCIe 80 GB box (sesterce-h100x2): gpus 2, the model split over both with BJ_DEVICE_MAP=auto (FP8 needs compute capability >= 8.9: the H100 has 9.0); mem_gb 150 is the total free memory over both GPUs (an idle H100 shows ~79 GiB free; the earlier 122B parts runs peaked at 129-130 GB), to be confirmed by the box agent. Same scenes, map, lens (published J++, pinned) and code path as qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_parts_r3, with --force for the cells (bypasses the map's transit filter: every family gets every cell; d1_verdict then uses the map's transit). Seeds: nulls 0, random dictionary 777 + layer, random subspace 888 + layer. Batch 16 for the read-heavy steps (as the other 122B specs). Timing basis: qwen35_122b_d1_topics2_parts_r3 ran 1842 s on one H200 for 9 cells x 2 families x 180 (51k reads); this run has 7 cells and 4 more reads per cell (~49k reads): ~0.5-0.7 h on one H200; split over two H100 PCIe (slower memory, the blocks run one GPU after the other) assumed 1.5-2x slower: ~0.8-1.2 h wall, est 2.4 GPU-h (2 GPUs). No depends_on: its inputs (the map, the competence run, the lens gate) are committed. Not opened before Dan predicts. H100 smoke (23 Oct): bind_bridge:30 reproduced within 3 points; context:30 moved 3.3 points and its recall control fell under 30% (hardware / two-GPU split noise: clean logits differ by 0.27 on average); Dan said launch; compare later layers with this run's own layer-30 cells, not with the H200 run's.

title: Late switch in tables and JSON (Qwen3.5-122B): the lens-readable part of a stated bridge at later layers

figures_command: BJ_TARGET=qwen3.5-122b-a10b uv run python scripts/d1_verdict.py --rule late-switch --parts qwen35_122b_d1_formats_late_parts_r2 --figures

why_it_matters: The second scene set for the late-switch test of qwen35_122b_d1_late_parts: finding 2 also failed on the 122B in tables and JSON at the map's cell (the context at layer 24: the lens part switched 41% [34, 48] of lookups, n=180; tables 49% [39, 59], n=88; JSON 34% [25, 44], n=92). A late switch in prose only, or in all three formats, reads differently.

hypotheses.H-late-switch: as qwen35_122b_d1_late_parts, pooled over both formats. Prior: Dan's (predictions/), none set by the agent

decision_rule: Written 23 Oct ~12:00 +0200 before any run: qwen35_122b_d1_late_parts's rule (scripts/d1_verdict.py --rule late-switch; same bars and controls; the agent's four choices confirmed by Dan 23 Oct 12:30), applied to the formats scenes pooled over tables and JSON. The hypothesis was named "late binding" until Dan renamed it "late switch" (23 Oct afternoon, before any run; the logic is unchanged): the map shows the bridge still at its position at the later layers, so the form changes, not the place. Late switch holds iff at some decisive cell the lens part's lookup switching has Wilson upper bound <= 0.05, the rest switches >= 0.30 of lookups (point), the lens part switches >= 0.30 of recalls there (point) with its Wilson lower bound above rand_sub's upper bound on recalls, and (amended by Dan 23 Oct 12:30, before any run) it stays quiet: at every later decisive cell of the same position set (the bridge's row / object, or the context) the lens part's lookup switching has Wilson upper bound <= 0.10, so a lens part that goes quiet and then comes back does not hold. Finding 2 fails iff at every decisive cell the lens part's lookup switching has Wilson lower bound >= 0.20 and above rand_sub's upper bound on lookups. Otherwise inconclusive. A cell decides iff the lens-free map qwen35_122b_d1_formats_map has it in transit for lookups: bind_bridge 30, context 30, 33 and 36; bind_bridge 33 and 36 are reported only (C's whole copy flips 48% and 44% of lookups there, not in transit). context:24 is the earlier reference, not decisive. Only layers 33 and 36 are new evidence: bind_bridge:30, context:30 and context:24 repeat cells of qwen35_122b_d1_formats_parts on the same 180 scenes (a determinism check, not new evidence). Reported as in qwen35_122b_d1_late_parts, including the rest at the lens part's size (not_jspace_matched, not decisive here). Per format (table 88 scenes, JSON 92 in the earlier run) and per topic the same rule on their rows, reported only (with ~90 items a Wilson upper bound <= 5% needs 0 switches).
controls: rand_sub: C's copy projected per row on a random subspace (seed 888 + layer) keeping the lens part's share of the row's squared norm
PM (recalls) on the same scenes as the positive control: the identical patch at statement cells
reported: not_jspace_matched (the rest, each row rescaled to the lens part's norm), jspace_matched, rand_omp, the lens part's random-direction null
the map's transit picks the decisive cells; the lens gate (qwen35_122b_lens_gate_v2, via scripts/d1_precheck.py)
determinism: bind_bridge:30, context:30 and context:24 repeat qwen35_122b_d1_formats_parts's cells on the same scenes (that run on one H200, this one split over two H100s)
